Cc: vendors@acmesupplies.com
Date: 2025-08-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question: invoice submission and PO stamping

Hi Diego,

Quick question as we start onboarding Redwood: does Redwood require invoices to be submitted only via the vendor portal, or can we continue to send invoices by email to billing@redwood.com for the first 60 days? A few related items:  

- Our ERP can emit a compact CSV and a single PDF per invoice. Do you need an additional checksum field (MD5/SHA1) for the PDF to support idempotency on your side?
- Is PO stamping required on the PDF itself, or is including the PO number in the subject line and the first invoice line sufficient?
- Any required minimal fields for line-items (unit price, SKU, tax code)?

Attaching a quick sample CSV we usually send (sample_template.csv) so your team can confirm mapping. We can also fill a vendor onboarding form if you prefer that route.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neal
Vendor Enablement Lead
Acme Supplies
Attachments: sample_template.csv
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@acmesupplies.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-27T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question: invoice submission and PO stamping

Hi Liam — thanks for the sample. Short answers up front: portal preferred but email is an acceptable short-term fallback; PO number must be machine-readable and present; checksum is optional but helpful for deduplication. Details below and a small checklist for your engineering/ops team.

Checklist / Requirements (minimum):
- Preferred channel: Redwood vendor portal (strongly recommended for production).
- Email fallback: send to billing@redwood.com with subject prefix: "INV: <PO#>" (e.g., INV: RWD-12345). If multiple invoices in one email, include PO in each invoice row.
- PO stamping: not strictly required on the PDF if the PO is present in the subject line AND as a dedicated PO column in the CSV. We rely on the CSV as the authoritative mapping.
- Minimal line-item fields: description, quantity, unit_price, currency, po_number. Tax code and SKU are optional but recommended.
- Checksum: optional MD5 of the attached PDF. If you include it, please name the header "pdf_md5" in CSV and attach the checksum value — this helps our ingest service avoid duplicates when gateway retries occur.
- Idempotency: we also accept an "invoice_reference" string (your internal invoice id) as a distinct field for idempotency.

Next steps: can you (1) confirm you can add a "po_number" column to the CSV and (2) send a single example invoice (CSV + PDF) using the subject prefix above? If you prefer the portal we can send an account invite today; otherwise we'll accept the email flow for a probationary 60-day period and monitor for mapping issues.

FYI tagging Monica (AP ops) and Karthik (procurement integrator) on the thread for onboarding / EDI questions.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Liam — confirmed, your sample looks good and the additional fields are sufficient for our ingest. A couple of operational notes before we flip the portal on or accept mass email traffic:  

1) Portal invite: we'll send a vendor portal invitation to the vendor contact email (liam.oneal@acmesupplies.com) using company-email identity by default. If you prefer SSO, let us know and we'll route to our SSO onboarding flow.

2) Acknowledgements: for email fallback we will return a simple JSON ack message to the sender address (from ack@redwood.com) within ~60s of successful ingest. Header: X-Redwood-Ack: {"invoice_id":"RWD-INV-<internal>","status":"accepted"}. We will also include the invoice_id in the ACK email subject for human reconciliation (ACK: RWD-INV-1234).

3) Idempotency logic: our system dedupes first on invoice_reference, then on pdf_md5 if invoice_reference is missing. If duplicates are detected we will return status: duplicate in the ack payload.

4) Go-live plan: portal invite + two-week probation where we accept both portal and email ingest and monitor for mapping issues. After that we will require portal-only.

Monica/Karthik: please confirm internal SLA for ack monitoring and whether finance wants the tax code field enforced at go-live.

Thanks — happy to run a short test batch tomorrow if that works for your team.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
